item.title: OpenSCAD Is Kinda Neat
item.description:
📝 OpenSCAD Is Kinda Neat Published December 20, 2025 Designing a simple battery holder in OpenSCAD. (The first cube() draws the main box, then difference() subtracts the battery holes via the second cube() as their quantity and location (via translate()) is iterated. I don’t understand this…) While this probably won’t be very helpful for more complicated designs, I can see this being super useful for bearing drifts, spacers, and other similar simple (yet incredibly useful in real life) geometric shapes.
🔗 Read more: https://nuxx.net/blog/2025/12/20/openscad-is-kinda-neat/
